description:
Red House
A red-brick apartment building built in the 1960s.

The 45-square-meter American-style apartment centers on cozy practicality, blending classic elements with modern design. An open layout breaks spatial constraints, while the integrated living-dining-kitchen area enhances a sense of spaciousness, complemented by natural tones like soft grays and creamy whites to create a comfortable ambiance. Solid wood furniture and linen/cotton textiles convey rustic charm, with accents like wrought iron pendant lights and vintage-inspired artwork adding nostalgic American flair. Glass partitions and hidden storage maximize vertical space efficiency, while simplified moldings and distressed finishes balance historical character with compact living needs. Ideal for singles or couples, it crafts a functional yet romantic mini-haven embodying the essence of Americana.

name: Bronze Statue of Old Man - Creality Sermoon P1
description:
## Scanning
Scanning was done with the Sermoon P1 in large IR mode with geometry tracking. The P1 was used standalone outdoors in bright sunlight, this caused initally some problems with auto exposure due to the very bright sky but with manual exposure corrected to the statue itself it worked very good.  
With initial firmware versions the P1 only could do 5-7fps in IR mode standalone, with the latest version it reaches a stable 19-20FPS. With the increased speed the scan only took roughly 5min without any tracking problems.

## Post-Processing
I then fused the scan at 1mm and meshed it with default settings. After meshing I performed color mapping. In postprocessing I decreased the contrast of the texture a bit (very harsh sunlight from the front).

name: Introscope
description:
Introscope

Sculpture “Introscope” is a temporary, freestanding mixed-media installation sculpture that engages Civic Center Plaza as a site of civic memory, visibility, and shared presence and essence. The work centers on an original hand-built clay sculptural face, sanke neck, heart and humming bird pieces referencing Xochipilli’s myth, his relationship with the feathered serpent Quetzalcoatl, and ancestors knowledge cult, Gamigin, on the back side, in its horse form, on display in the back, signaling the importance of finding equilibrium by being aware of all aspects of our psyche and collectives.

Together, these views invite reflection on how public identity and internal experience coexist within civic life. Reflecting on the relevance of a healthy ego, and as an introduction to the individual, local or stranger, to our plural society, in which we welcome, respect and praise, moreover, actively practice, and venerate originality, peculiarity, presence, and purpose. 
“We are all just visitors here”.

name: Liquid Island- Optim30P100
description:
Sur une île qui hésite entre matière et rêve,
où la terre semble fondre comme un souvenir trop doux,
un guitariste s’est arrêté.
Ses doigts effleurent les cordes
comme on caresse le silence,
et chaque note tombe lentement
dans l’eau immobile qui respire sous lui.
À ses côtés, un chien veille —
fidèle gardien d’un monde qui s’écoule,
les yeux perdus entre l’horizon liquide
et les échos invisibles de la musique.
Les arbres, ronds comme des pensées tranquilles,
se penchent pour écouter,
et la petite maison suspendue
retient son souffle, accrochée au temps.
Tout glisse, tout fond, tout pourrait disparaître —
sauf ce moment fragile
où un homme, un chien,
et une mélodie
tiennent encore l’univers en équilibre.

name: Sarajevo Vijećnica / Sarajevo City Hall
description:
Sarajevo City Hall, known as Vijećnica, is one of the most iconic landmarks of Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is a masterpiece of architecture that blends historical influences with rich artistic details, symbolizing Sarajevo’s multicultural heritage. 

The construction began in 1892 and was completed in 1894, designed by the Czech architect Karel Pařík. However, due to disagreements over the design, Pařík was replaced, and the final project was completed by Alexander Wittek and Ćiril Iveković.

Vijećnica is a prime example of Moorish Revival architecture, a style inspired by Islamic and North African (Moorish) design elements, which was popular in Europe during the late 19th century. The Austro-Hungarians chose this style to emphasize Sarajevo’s Ottoman past while integrating it into the European architectural landscape.

The model is devided into instances so it is optimized for game engines. The glass material behind the Grant Entrance can be swapped for a parallax material to show the inside of the Hall.

name: 北辛武村太和岩碑楼
description:
山西介休，北辛武琉璃牌坊，正式名称为太和岩牌楼，是一座位于山西省介休市义安镇北辛武村的清代琉璃建筑。它坐北朝南，四柱三门三楼式，建于石砌束腰须弥座上，高 8.5 米，长 9.65 米，宽 1.55 米。
建筑特点：
1：牌坊的屋顶为单檐歇山顶，铺以黄、绿相间的琉璃脊瓦和吻兽，色彩鲜艳，造型庄重。
2：明间设七踩三翘斗拱七攒，次间置五踩单翘单昂斗拱五攒。
3：牌坊的额枋斗拱、门楣牌匾、勾滴瓦垄等均为琉璃构件，图案丰富多样，包括花卉、文字、龙纹、瑞兽等。
4：琉璃饰件运用了仿线刻、仿高浮雕、透雕等多种表现形式，并融入了绘画技法，展现了高超的工艺水平。

历史背景：
该牌坊建于清光绪二十三年（1897 年），由北辛武村的晋商巨富冀氏家族的冀以和建造。
最初是为了补修村内的七座庙宇，特别是真武庙而建。
尽管真武庙已不复存在，但琉璃牌坊作为独立的建筑保存下来。
2006 年，被国务院公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。

name: The Knight of Tomorrow
description:
**The Knight of Tomorrow**

Hi everyone! I want to share my personal project  a stylized 3D character built entirely from scratch.

The concept is based on my original idea: a cute, pint-sized knight giving his absolute best and using all his strength to pull his sword from the stone.

My main focus was to push my limits as a 3D Generalist and master character rigging and animation. As a solo artist, I handled the entire production pipeline single-handedly:

•	**Concept & Design**: Crafting the character's look, story, and personality.

•	**Modeling:** Creating clean, animation-ready topology in Blender.

•	**Texturing:** Creating rich, stylized materials in Substance Painter.

•	**Rigging & Animation:** Building a custom skeleton and animating the heavy-lifting struggle in Blender.

**The model is available for download! **Feel free to grab it, break it down, and check out the rig and topology. I’ll keep refining my skills, so any feedback in the comments is highly appreciated!

The Castle of Guimarães
description:
The Castle of Guimarães (Portuguese: Castelo de Guimarães) is the principal medieval castle in the municipality Guimarães, in the northern region of Portugal. It was built under the orders of Mumadona Dias in the 10th century to defend the monastery from attacks by Moors and Norsemen.

The castle is a military fortification grounded primarily in the late Romanesque period, and elaborated during the early Gothic epoch of Portuguese architecture. Its area is delineated by walls forming a pentagram, similar to a shield, that includes eight rectangular towers, military square and central keep. Originating in the foundations of a Roman structure, from the writings of Alfredo Guimarães, it was later elaborated on the French model, in its current the form of a shield, with reduced central yard and difficult accesses. It includes several Gothic characteristics, owing to its remodelling at the end of the 13th century.

Location: Guimaraes, Portugal

name: Vehicles>Human>Ground>Mammoth
description: Nearly seventy meters in length, the Mammoth is a six-wheeled siegeworks ultra-heavy vehicle that fulfills the dual roles of anti-aircraft and anti-warship weapons platform; it is designed for the elimination of hostile vessels, weapons, and fortifications in terrestrial and orbital positions. As with the Elephant, the Mammoth possesses an internal storage bay for smaller vehicles such as the M12 Warthog and the M274 Mongoose and their variants, which are normally stored via magnetic grapples running along the roof of the bay and can exit through the vehicle's front or back ramp. The Mammoth sports a single Mark 2457/35cm HRG Mini-MAC turret on the topside, two large openings towards the back, as well as two smaller ones near the vehicle's cockpit. Two M79 MLRS emplacements are mounted on both the port and starboard side for close-in defense. It is generally painted in a camel brown scheme.

description:
The Monza Circuit, officially called the Autodromo Nazionale Monza, is a 5.793 km (3.600 mi) race track near the city of Monza, north of Milan, in Italy. Built in 1922, it was the world's third purpose-built motor racing circuit after Brooklands and Indianapolis, and the oldest in mainland Europe. The circuit's biggest event is the Italian Grand Prix. With the exception of the 1980 running when the track was closed while undergoing refurbishment, the race has been hosted there since 1949. The circuit is also known as "the Temple of Speed" due to its long straights and high-speed corners.

name: Kultura3D - Small Synagogue, Włodawa, Poland
description: The Small Synagogue in Włodawa, also known as the old bet ha-midrash, was built in the late 18th century and is documented in written sources from 1782–1786. It served both as a house of prayer and as a place for studying the Torah and Talmud. Its modest architecture reflects the practical role of a small-town Jewish study house, with a men's prayer hall, a western vestibule and a women's gallery above it. The building was renovated in 1915–1916, when the shape of its windows was altered. During World War II, almost all of its original furnishings, including the bimah and Aron ha-Kodesh, were destroyed, and the building was used as a shop and military warehouse. Today it forms part of the Museum – Synagogue Complex in Włodawa. This 3D model was created by Kultura3D using photogrammetry to digitally document and preserve this important monument of Jewish heritage in eastern Poland.

name: Loggerhead sea turtle
description:
3D scan of the skull of an adult loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*). 

The loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*) is a species of oceanic turtle belonging to the family Cheloniidae distributed throughout the world. It is found in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as the Mediterranean Sea. The average loggerhead measures around 90 cm in carapace length when fully grown and the adult weighs approximately 135 kg, with the largest specimens weighing in at more than 450 kg.
The loggerhead sea turtle is omnivorous, feeding mainly on bottom-dwelling invertebrates. Its large and powerful jaws serve as an effective tool for dismantling its prey.

Specimen: Loggerhead sea turtle, *Caretta caretta* (Linnaeus, 1758)

Inventory number: B 32

name: Kissing Bug (Rhodnius robustus) - Patasyacu, ECU
description:
This kissing bug (*Rhodnius robustus*) was collected in Patasyacu, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Rhodnius robustus* is a vector of Chagas disease in several countries of Central and South America (including Ecuador).

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.2 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

description:
**Spanish**
Material: Piedra arenisca
Fecha: Siglos II-I a.C.
Procedencia: Santuario del Cerro de los Santos (Montealegre del Castillo, Albacete)
La iconografía y onomástica de las inscripciones votivas o funerarias reflejan el proceso de romanización de las poblaciones locales, que siguen manteniendo la devoción a sus dioses, como este exvoto que representa a un "togado", es decir, un ibero que habría adoptado la vestimenta y el nombre romano.

**English**
Material: Sandstone
Date: 2nd-1st century BC
Location: Shrine of Cerro de los Santos (Montealegre del Castillo, Albacete)
The iconography and onomastics of the votive or funerary inscriptions reflect the gradual Romanisation of the local peoples who continued to worship their own gods, as illustrated by this ex-voto of a togatus—in other words, an Iberian who had adopted Roman dress and a Roman name.

description:
High-quality Low-Poly urban commercial building featuring street-level storefronts with graffiti wall art, upper office floors, and detailed rooftop elements. Fully optimized for game engines (Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot).

Key Features:
- **Game-Ready & Optimized Topology**: Clean quad-based geometry, highly efficient for mobile and PC games.
- **Urban Details**: Includes street graffiti art, "Welcome" store awning, AC units, drainage pipes, rooftop antenna, and protective railings.
- **PBR Texturing**: Detailed PBR maps (Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Metallic) for realistic material response under dynamic lighting.
- **Efficient UV Unwrapping**: Non-overlapping UVs with proper padding to avoid resolution bleeding.
- **Versatile Use**: Ideal for city blocks, downtown street scenes, indie games, and post-apocalyptic or modern urban environments.

name: Terracotta Amphora (Met Object ID 247265)
description:
**Attic Amphora (ca. 500 BCE)**

This 3D model depicts an ancient Greek Attic Amphora, a vessel which contained wine, grain, and oil for storage and transport. Created in 500 BCE and attributed to the Nikoxenos Painter, the original ceramic vessel is an example of Classical Athenian pottery and reflects the social and artistic traditions of ancient Greece, depicting the King of Troy, Priam, taking refuge at the alter of Zeus Herkeois.

The model was generated using Microsoft’s Trellis AI system from publicly available images of the original artifact in The Metropolitan Museum of Art’s Open Access Collection (Object ID 247265). It should be considered a digital reconstruction rather than a precise archaeological scan.

Source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access Collection.

name: KIRIK KIRIK BIRU (BLUE THROATED BEE EATER)
description:
Kirik-kirik biru merupakan burung berukuran sedang dengan tubuh ramping dan bulu berwarna mencolok. Panjang tubuhnya berkisar 21–23 cm, dengan dua helai bulu ekor tengah yang memanjang dan runcing, menambah kesan elegan saat terbang. Kepala dan tengkuk berwarna cokelat kemerahan, kontras indah dengan tenggorokan dan dada biru terang yang menjadi ciri khasnya.

Bagian punggung dan sayap atas berwarna hijau zamrud berkilau, sementara bagian bawah tubuh menampilkan gradasi biru kehijauan yang lembut. Paruhnya panjang, hitam, dan melengkung ke bawah, disertai mata merah tua yang memberikan ekspresi tajam dan fokus.

Kakinya sangat kecil dan ramping, berwarna hitam keabu-abuan, tampak mungil dibandingkan tubuhnya. Struktur kakinya yang terdiri dari tiga jari menghadap ke depan dan satu ke belakang memudahkannya untuk bertengger di ranting atau kawat tipis. Saat terbang, kirik-kirik biru tampak lincah dan anggun dengan sayap runcing dan gerakan melayang yang halus.

ペルシャ（ハルシャ）の織物に見立ててハルシャガイという和名がつけられた。

Orange spots form rows like bricks. It inhabits clean sandy bottoms among coral reefs and seaweed beds.

name: 1994 Benetton B194
description:
The Benetton B194 is a Formula One racing car designed by Rory Byrne for use by the Benetton team in the 1994 Formula One World Championship.

The car was closely based on its predecessors the B193, and powered by a Ford Zetec-R V8 engine, designed and developed by Geoff Goddard. The electronic driver aids that had such an effect on F1 over the previous seasons were banned, so the car had to be redesigned with the new rules in mind. The B194 was a light and nimble car and was most competitive in the hands of Schumacher on twisty tracks, unlike the early Williams FW16 which proved difficult to drive thanks to Williams's dependence on electronic driving aids in the previous season. Michael Schumacher's B194 remained the most competitive driver/car combination until Williams introduced a B-spec car at the German Grand Prix.

![](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/6e/a9/37/6ea93727b8c7e5cd78222d0697ef4c69.jpg)

name: Viserion - The White Dragon
description:

name: Dinglin Temple Pagoda
description:
The Dinglin Temple Pagoda is located at the northwest foot of Fangshan in Jiangning District, Nanjing City. It is also known as the Fangshan Leaning Pagoda, with a northward inclination of 7.59 degrees, surpassing the famous Leaning Pagoda of Pisa in Italy, and is still known as the "world's number one Leaning Pagoda".
The Dinglin Temple Pagoda was first built in the ninth year of the Qiandao reign of the Southern Song Dynasty (1173 AD), with a height of about 14.50 meters. It is a seven level, eight sided brick pagoda with a wooden like structure. The bottom and second floors are square in shape, while the third and above floors are cylindrical. Install a wooden frame on the fifth floor to support the brake lever. The bottom floor only opens to the south, with a stone carved Sumeru pedestal in the center and Buddhist niches on the east, west, and north sides. All other floors have doors on all four sides.

name: Circuit Zolder
description:
The Circuit Zolder, also known as Circuit Terlamen, is an undulating 4.011 km (2.492 mi) motorsport race track in Heusden-Zolder, Belgium.

Designed by John Hugenholtz and built in 1963, Zolder hosted the Formula One Belgian Grand Prix on 10 separate occasions in the 1970s and 1980s, as well as the 1980 Belgian motorcycle Grand Prix. F1 moved to Zolder in 1973 and with the exception of two races at Nivelles-Baulers in 1972 and 1974 (both won by Emerson Fittipaldi), Zolder was the location of the Belgian Grand Prix until 1982. That year, Canadian driver Gilles Villeneuve was killed during qualifying at the 1982 Belgian Grand Prix. Villeneuve's Ferrari 126C2 collided at speed with the March 821 of Jochen Mass. The Ferrari was torn up in the accident and when rolling, Villeneuve was thrown from the car.

name: Dinoraul's Brachiosaurus Althitorax Accurate
description:
Credit to @SaurustheModeler
Brachiosaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived in North America during the Late Jurassic, about 155.6 to 145.5 million years ago. It was first described by American paleontologist Elmer S. Riggs in 1903 from fossils found in the Colorado River valley in western Colorado, United States. Riggs named the dinosaur Brachiosaurus altithorax; the generic name is Greek for "arm lizard", in reference to its proportionately long arms, and the specific name means "deep chest". Brachiosaurus is estimated to have been between 18 and 22 meters (59 and 72 ft) long; body mass estimates of the subadult holotype specimen range from 28.3 to 46.9 metric tons (31.2 to 51.7 short tons). It had a disproportionately long neck, small skull, and large overall size, all of which are typical for sauropods. Atypically, Brachiosaurus had longer forelimbs than hindlimbs, which resulted in a steeply inclined trunk, and a proportionally shorter tail.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brachiosaurus

JJJ did all the sculpting and texture work, I added the bones and made it fully useable for MMD and other programs.

name: TPMS Gyroid Cube — Architected Metamaterial
description:
3D CAD representation of a Gyroid Triply Periodic Minimal Surface (TPMS) cubic lattice unit cell, engineered for high stiffness-to-weight ratio, isotropic mechanical response, and advanced additive manufacturing.

🔬 Technical Details:

- Surface Topology: Gyroid TPMS (Triply Periodic Minimal Surface)
- Unit Cell Architecture: Continuous, non-intersecting chiral channels with zero sharp corners to prevent stress concentration and fatigue failure.
- Applications: Metal Additive Manufacturing (LPBF / SLS), FEA Mechanical Simulation, Energy Absorbers, Heat Exchangers, and Biomimetic Tissue Scaffolds.

Designed for research into architected materials, unit cell parameterization, and mechanical testing evaluation under uniaxial compression.

👨‍🔬 Created by: Dr. Shahadat Hussain
🌐 Research & Insights: https://www.shahadathussain.com

name: CIRIK CIRIK KUMBANG (RED-BEARDED BEE-EATER)
description:
Cirikcirik Kumbang adalah burung berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh sekitar 25–27 cm, dikenal karena janggut lebat berwarna merah terang di bagian dagu hingga tenggorokan. Janggut ini menjadi ciri pembeda utamanya, tampak kontras dengan kepala berwarna hijau gelap kebiruan yang memberi kesan tegas dan eksotis.

Bulu tubuh bagian atas didominasi hijau zamrud, sementara bagian bawah tubuh menampilkan gradasi hijau yang lebih cerah. Dahi dan pipinya berwarna ungu-biru gelap, memadukan nuansa kuat dengan area merah mencolok di bawahnya. Iris matanya berwarna cokelat kehitaman, berpadu dengan paruh panjang melengkung berwarna hitam, tipikal pemakan serangga terbang.

Sayap burung ini tampak kokoh dengan rentang hijau gelap kehitaman, mendukung kemampuan terbang lincah saat mengejar mangsa. Ekornya relatif panjang dan bertahap runcing, tanpa helai

description:
**PL**- 
Dzwon odlany jest ze stopu metali w kształcie kielichowym o rozmiarach 90 x115 cm (wys. x szer.). Forma złożona jest z czapy, płaszcza, wieńca i serca (brak korony).Krótka szyja płaszcza dekorowana jest półwałkami i wąskim fryzem z przeplecionych arkadek wzbogaconych motywem akantu.   W górnej partii płaszcza znajduje się jednowersowa inskrypcja /„FRIEDE  AUF  ERDEN”/oraz data 1928.

**EN**- 
*The bell is cast from a metal alloy in the shape of a cup, measuring 90 x 115 cm (height x width). The form consists of a head, a shoulder, a waist, a sound bow and a clapper (no canons).The upper part of the waist is decorated with narrow belts and a narrow frieze of intertwined arcades enriched with an acanthus motif. In the upper part of the waist there is a single-line inscription /”FRIEDE  AUF  ERDEN” /and the date 1928.*

name: Ivysaur
description:
A low-poly **Ivysaur model** designed for a **Minecraft Bedrock Edition addon**, combining the recognizable Pokémon design with Minecraft’s blocky and geometric visual style.

The model features a compact quadrupedal body, sturdy legs, pointed ears, expressive eyes, and the characteristic large flower bud growing from its back, surrounded by broad leaves. Its proportions are adapted to fit naturally within Minecraft while maintaining Ivysaur’s distinctive silhouette and personality.

The geometry is lightweight and optimized for real-time use in Minecraft Bedrock, making it suitable for custom animations such as idle, walking, running, attacking, taking damage, fainting, and battle poses.

name: P-40 1S12 Radar
description:
The P-40 "Armour" or 1S12 (also referred to by the NATO reporting name "Long Track" in the west) is a 3-D UHF radar developed and operated by the former Soviet Union.

The P-40 started development in 1960 and by 1962 the radar had completed state trails and in 1963 was accepted into service by the anti-aircraft troops of the Soviet armed forces.

In 1965 the P-40 gained the GRAU designation 1S12 as it was adopted as the target acquisition radar of the 2K11 Krug mobile anti-aircraft defence system.

The P-40 was developed by Scientific Research Institute #208 GKRE, which later became known as NIIIP of Minradioprom, OKB-588 (later Lianozovskiy Electromechanical Plant, LEMZ) also assisted in the production of the prototype.

Between the 1966 and 1968 the radar was upgraded, increasing the range of the system. Later, between 1969 and 1970, the radar's range was again improved in addition to achieving better reliability. 

The P-40 was the first high-mobility radar to enter into service with the then new tactical

name: Nuraghe Palmavera Alghero by Alessio Langella
description:
Il Complesso Nuragico di Palmavera, importante sito archeologico di Alghero, in Sardegna, è riprodotto in questo modello realizzato per l'evento "Monumenti aperti".
 Offre agli studenti dell'Istituto Tecnico Industriale di Alghero (via degli Orti) l'opportunità di esplorare e comprendere meglio questa affascinante eredità culturale risalente all'età del bronzo. Il modellino riproduce fedelmente l'architettura e la disposizione delle strutture tipiche della civiltà nuragica, come il nuraghe, la torre di avvistamento e le capanne. 
Attraverso questo modello, gli studenti possono osservare i dettagli costruttivi, le tecniche di lavorazione della pietra e le funzioni di ciascun elemento, approfondendo la conoscenza della civiltà nuragica e apprezzando la ricchezza del patrimonio culturale sardo.
A cura di Alessio Langella per e con gli studenti dell'ITI di Alghero
Qui potrai trovare dei link di approfondimento all'insegna del "ludendo docere".

[...] Red foxes are usually found in pairs or small groups consisting of families, such as a mated pair and their young, or a male with several females having kinship ties. ~ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_fox

name: Hin Halidzor Հին Հալիձոր Старый Алидзор
description:
Древнее поселение Старый Алидзор упоминается с X века как «Հալէ» (Але) или «Հալիս» (Алис). В X веке принцесса Амазаспуи (Համազասպուհի) подарила его Татевскому монастырю. Село расположено на левом берегу реки Воротан на высоте 1300–1350 метров над уровнем моря. Традиционные каменные дома строились каскадом, где крыша нижнего дома служила двором для верхнего. Сохранились руины церкви Сурб Минас (XVII век) и старинное кладбище с хачкарами. Село было окончательно заброшено в 1960–70-х годах. Жители переехали в новое село Алидзор (Nor Halidzor), построенное в 1966 году чуть выше по склону.
Հին Հալիձորը գտնվում է Սյունիքի մարզում՝ Որոտան գետի ձախ ափին: Այն պատմական հնագույն բնակավայր է, որը հիշատակվում է դեռևս 10-րդ դարից: Գյուղը հայտնի է իր յուրահատուկ թերասաձև ճարտարա-պետությամբ, որտեղ տների տանիքները ծառայել են որպես բակ վերևի հարևանների համար: Գյուղի կենտրոնում է գտնվում 1611թ. կառուցված Սուրբ Մինաս եկեղեցին: Բնակիչները տեղափոխվել են նոր Հալիձոր 1966 թվականին:

name: Etruscan seal (right astragalus)
description:
3D scan of the right astragalus of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

name: Drum Castle, Aberdeenshire
description:
Drum Castle, near Drumoak, Aberdeenshire, was seat of Clan Irvine chiefs for over 650 years. Its name derives from Gaelic druim (“ridge”). Located 6.5 miles NE of Banchory, it is now owned by the National Trust for Scotland and open to visitors.

The original 13th-century tower, possibly by Richard Cementarius, is among Scotland’s oldest unaltered tower houses. Robert the Bruce granted the estate to William de Irwyn in 1323, and the Irvines held it until 1975. The castle was attacked during the Covenanting Rebellion and later expanded: a Jacobean wing (1619), Victorian alterations, and 19th-century courtyard restoration by Alexander Forbes Irvine.

Since 1987 Drum has been a Category A listed building; The castle features a Victorian library (4,000+ books), fine furniture, paintings, stained glass, and the Augsburg silver Madonna. 

642 photographs taken using Mavic 2 Pro drone, processed using Agisoft Metashape. Permission granted by NTS.

name: Kirchenruine
description:
Church ruin in Leithaprodersdorf. The complex was originally a three-nave medieval parish church, whose floor plan and walls are still clearly visible today. A particularly characteristic feature is the Romanesque semicircular apse, whose masonry has been largely preserved despite the destruction. The construction features typical Romanesque elements, including massive stone blocks, narrow window openings, and a clear, functional layout of the interior.

The nave consisted of three aisles separated by pillars or columns, as was common for Romanesque village churches in eastern Central Europe. Remains of the south aisle and parts of the choir room give an idea of the original proportions. 

The destruction took place in 1683 during the Turkish Wars, when the town was severely damaged. The ruins remained unused and fell into disrepair for more than two centuries. It was not until 1907 that safety measures were taken to restore and structurally stabilize the remaining walls.

name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps 1992 layout
description:
The 1992 Belgian Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held at Spa-Francorchamps on 30 August 1992. It was the twelfth race of the 1992 Formula One World Championship. The 44-lap race was won by Michael Schumacher, driving a Benetton-Ford. This was the first Grand Prix win for a German driver since Jochen Mass at the 1975 Spanish Grand Prix, and the first of an eventual record 91 Grand Prix wins for Schumacher (since eclipsed by Lewis Hamilton in 2020). New World Champion Nigel Mansell finished second in his Williams-Renault with teammate Riccardo Patrese third, thus securing the Constructors' Championship for Williams. Schumacher's win, which was the first full-length Grand Prix won by a German since Wolfgang von Trips's last win at the 1961 British Grand Prix, marked the last time a Formula One car to win a Grand Prix while sporting a H-pattern manual gearbox. This race also marked Ferrari's 500th start in a World Championship event as a team, and the last race for Andrea Moda

Source: Asetto Corsa

This architectural project, titled 'The Literary Loop', is a museum designed for the Musashino University, Musashino Campus. The central theme of the design is 'Circuit', reflecting the natural flow and connectivity of the existing campus landscape.

The museum is structured to encourage organic exploration. By utilizing a skip-floor system and strategically placed open galleries, the design blurs the boundaries between reading, viewing, and social interaction. The floor plan features a continuous flow that connects the foyer, the cafe, and various reading zones, ensuring that visitors experience a sense of discovery as they navigate through the diverse spatial heights and functional zones.

name: Thomastown: Dunnamaggin stoup
description:
A holy water stoup originally from Dunnamaggin, now in Thomastown. The owner (steward) says that his father rescued it from Dunnamaggin in the late 1970s, when it was "thrown out" of the old church which was the RC church building before the current one, not the medieval building. But most likely, it was originally from that one. It is very similar in style to the [Dunnamaggin baptismal font](https://skfb.ly/pssUo) and was probably carved by the same artist. It has 3 trefoil carvings in one of the top corners whereas the baptismal font has no such decorations; some fonts of the Ossory type do, though ([Maddoxtown](https://skfb.ly/ptnFN) and [St Canice's Cathedral](https://skfb.ly/p7ZBz), for example). The architectue depicted is also very similar to [one of the stoups at Ballyhale](https://skfb.ly/ptqBE).

SMR no.: KK028-040006- (pers.comm. with Jean Farrelly).

Made in KiriEngine from 139 images.

name: REPAIR / REUPLOAD POST
description:
Over the past year, we have integrated many models into this repository, but over time we have improved many aspects of each of the available references, so much so that there is a very big difference between the first models and the most recent ones.

For this reason, we have received numerous requests to review and correct some of the earlier uploaded models to match the quality of the more recent ones.

In response to these requests, we have created this space for you to indicate which models you need UV corrected, updated, or re-uploaded (rigging does not count).

The conditions are as follows:

1. Each user may choose a maximum of **2** models.
2. The chosen model must currently be in the catalog of uploaded designs.
3. The user must indicate the flaw in the model so that it can be corrected.
4. **30** models will be chosen at random

You can also suggest updating an existing model for a better one, either because it has errors or because they would like one with a greater level of detail to be uploaded.

name: Relief of the Nativity – Museum of Burgos
description: This model is based on the Relief of the Nativity, preserved at the Museum of Burgos and created in the 16th century. The artwork depicts the birth of Jesus Christ, with the Virgin Mary and Saint Joseph beside the Christ Child, accompanied by the ox and the donkey, traditional symbols of this biblical scene. The relief reflects the characteristic features of the Spanish Renaissance, with highly expressive figures, balanced compositions, and remarkable attention to detail in the folds of the garments and the facial features of the characters. The relief was most likely part of an altarpiece intended for religious worship. In addition to its artistic value, it served a didactic purpose, helping the faithful understand biblical episodes through imagery. . This model was created from photographs taken by an Artmonite collaborator. Download this model at:https://artmonite.com/en/product/relieve-de-la-natividad-museo-de-burgos/

name: Panathenaic Stadium
description:
A unique archaeological monument, a living symbol of the ancient and modern heritage of sport and the Olympic Games. The ancient stadium was constructed around 330 BC by the Athenian orator and politician Lycurgus. The stadium was the place where the athletic games of the Great Panathenaeans were held.

The first systematic excavations were carried out in 1869/1870 by the German architect Ernst Ziller. The idea of reconstructing was realized a few years later, in 1896, on the occasion of the revival of the modern Olympic Games at an international level and their first organization in Athens. Leading figures in the history of the revival were the French baron Pierre de Coubertin, the scholar Dimitrios Vikelas and the great sponsor of the Games, Georgios Averoff, who played a central role in the period 1894-1896.

The scan is a result of over 4.000 aerial photos. This is a low detail model. For more information please contact me.

The work was supported by an NEH grant, and the grant team included UW-Stout, Cultural Heritage Imaging, and Mia.

name: Odesa Archaeological Museum
description:
The building of the Odesa Archaeological Museum of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. The building was constructed in 1883 on Lanzheronivska Street. The project was designed by architect Feliks Gąsiorowski for the public Library and Museum of the Society of History and Antiquities and was built at the expense of Mayor Grigorios Maraslis. In 1907, the library moved to another building, and the Museum still exists in the building today.
Model simplified from 1.2b. triangles. A detailed interior plan was created in the course of the project as well. 

*The model was digitized in the course of the project “Ukrainian Heritage Digitization and Dissemination Initiative,” supported by the US Embassy in Ukraine (Kyiv) and the Ambassador’s Fund for Cultural Preservation. It is a joint ownership of the Odesa Archaeological Museum of the NAS of Ukraine, non-profit organization “CyArk” and NGO “Scientific Research Lab “Archaic”. *

- Wooden seating slats
- Curved ergonomic geometry
- Designed for public and outdoor spaces
- Industrial and contemporary aesthetic

It is classified as an allosaurid, a type of carnosaurian theropod dinosaur.

name: Tapered LWIC over Metal Deck
description:
This exploded 3D model illustrates a Lightweight Insulating Concrete (LWIC) roofing system, with each layer separated to clearly show material sequencing. LWIC is poured over tapered EPS insulation to provide slope on a flat structural metal deck, with LWIC also used to infill the flutes beneath. This setup achieves slope-to-drain without altering the structure and enhances roof performance. LWIC systems offer over 70 years of lifespan, reduced maintenance, and strong fire and wind resistance. 

The insulating concrete protects the EPS board and maintains R-value, even when the membrane is replaced. With proven sustainability and faster installation schedules, this system supports energy-efficient, durable building envelopes. This model is ideal for contractors, architects, and building owners looking to visualize high-performance roof insulation solutions. Proudly developed by the team at Cell-Crete Corporation, industry leaders in lightweight concrete and insulation systems.

name: Pelecanimimus
description: from carnivores dh (carnivores dinosaur hunter reborn) It is an NPC in the game that cannot be collected in the trophy room. (It lived in the early Cretaceous period, just over 125 million years ago, in the Barremian, in what is now Europe. Its exceptionally well-preserved fossil remains have been found at the Las Hoyas site in Cuenca, Spain. It is notable for having more teeth than any other member of Ornithomimosauria, most of which are toothless. The only known specimen consists of the articulated front half of a skeleton including the skull, all the neck and most of the dorsal vertebrae, ribs, sternum, pectoral girdle, the complete right forelimb and most of the left. The specific name, Pelecanimimus polyodon, from the Greek polys, "many," plus odus, teeth, was given because it was the toothiest theropod known.)

It inhabits North, Central and South America, making it the most widely distributed wild, terrestrial mammal in the Western Hemisphere, and one of the most widespread in the world. Its range spans Yukon, British Columbia and Alberta in Canada, the Rocky Mountains and areas in the western United States. Further south, its range extends through Mexico to the Amazon rainforest and the southern Andes Mountains in Patagonia. ETAIN - Task 4.1 Development of 3D-EM Insect Models 

CT scan to 3D model process made by [Felipe Ribas](https://orcid.org/0009-0003-0433-4542) using Blender.

Introducing inverse kinematics and animation into simulations of RF EMF is highly beneficial for visualizing Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) and the pattern of electric fields in various positions, as they naturally occur. name: Landmark 81
description:
Landmark 81 is a supertall skyscraper in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is primarily invested in and developed by Vinhomes, the largest Vietnamese real-estate developer. Landmark 81 holds the position of the tallest building in Vietnam, the second-tallest building in Southeast Asia, as well as the seventeenth-tallest building in the world overall.

The 461.2-metre-tall (1,513 ft), 81-story building is located where the Newport logistics base was on the western banks of the Saigon River in Thạnh Mỹ Tây ward, located in the northeast side of Ho Chi Minh City's historic center and to the immediate southern side of Saigon Bridge. The Nile crocodile (*Crocodylus niloticus*) is a large crocodilian native to freshwater habitats in Africa, widely distributed in sub-Saharan Africa, mostly in the eastern, southern, and central regions of the continent. It lives in different types of aquatic environments such as lakes, rivers, swamps, and marshlands. Adult males ranges between 3.5 and 5 m in length and weighs 225 to 750 kg. They are are opportunistic apex predators, feeding on different species of fish, reptiles, birds, and mammals.

name: Helicopter - Bell 207 sioux scout
description:
The Bell 207 Sioux Scout, developed in 1963, was an experimental light attack helicopter built to explore the concept of a dedicated armed scout aircraft for the U.S. Army. Although it never entered production, it introduced several key innovations that became standard features in later attack helicopters.

The 207 combined a slim tandem cockpit, stub wings for weapons, and a chin-mounted gun turret—layout choices that were groundbreaking at the time. It was also one of the first helicopters designed from the start for armed reconnaissance rather than being a modified utility airframe. This made it a true precursor to purpose-built attack helicopters.

While the Sioux Scout itself was only a testbed, it directly influenced the design philosophy of later aircraft such as the Bell AH-1 Cobra. Many of its features-tandem seating, narrow fuselage, integrated weapons systems, and improved pilot visibility—became defining characteristics of modern attack rotorcraft.

Model made on Blender

name: KIRIK KIRIK SULAWESI
description:
Kirik-kirik Sulawesi merupakan burung endemik berukuran sedang dari Pulau Sulawesi, dengan panjang tubuh mencapai 24–25 cm. Ciri khas utamanya terletak pada janggot lebat berwarna ungu kehitaman yang menonjol di daerah dagu dan tenggorokan bagian bawah, memberikan kesan dramatis pada tampilan wajahnya.

Bulu tubuh bagian atas umumnya berwarna hijau zaitun gelap, kontras dengan dada dan perut berwarna ungu keunguan yang kaya dan dalam. Kepala dan pipinya tampak lebih gelap, seringkali tampak seperti menyatu dengan paruh yang panjang, hitam, dan melengkung khas keluarga pemakan serangga terbang.

Sayapnya berwarna hijau zaitun kehitaman dengan kilau metalik samar saat terkena cahaya. Ekor kirik-kirik ini terdiri dari bulu panjang berbentuk meruncing mengikuti tubuh, tanpa helai ekor ekstrem seperti yang dimili, memberi kesan tenang dan uh konsentrasi.

Kakinya kecil dan berwarna gelap, berfungsi terutama untuk bertengger di ranting-ranting rendah hutan dataran rendah dan perbukitan.

name: HÁBITA
description:
HABITA es un atelier de arquitectura concebido como un espacio creativo integral, donde el diseño, la experimentación y la materialización de ideas conviven en un ambiente abierto y funcional. El concepto del atelier se basa en generar una atmósfera que inspire habitar el proceso creativo: un lugar donde la arquitectura se piensa, se construye y se vive.

El espacio se organiza a partir de una gran mesa de trabajo central que actúa como el corazón del atelier, permitiendo desarrollar proyectos en gran formato y fomentar la colaboración. A su alrededor, se distribuyen áreas complementarias como la zona de maquetas, diseñada para exhibir propuestas y analizar volumetrías, y la sala para atención a clientes, destinada a presentar ideas en un ambiente profesional y controlado. La recepción y la oficina refuerzan el funcionamiento operativo del lugar, manteniendo una imagen ordenada y coherente con la identidad del estudio.

description:
Die Burgruine Heldenburg
Sie wurde im 13. Jahrhundert zum Schutz des Salzbrunnens von den Grafen von Dassel und von den Welfenherzögen gebaut.
In den 50er Jahren fanden hier gut besuchte Burgfestspiele statt, daneben gab es ein Museum mit Ritterrüstungen in der Burgschänke.
Die Burgruine wurde in den Jahren 1983 – 1988 grundlegend saniert. Die Ruine ist im Besitz des Landes Niedersachsen.
Der Förderverein Heldenburg Salzderhelden e.V. betreut die Burg und organisiert seit 1984 Ausgrabungen, Burggottesdienste und Veranstaltungen.

name: Teatro Romano de Merida | MERIDA - SPAIN
description:
The Roman Theatre of Mérida is a Roman theatre in the Roman colonia of Emerita Augusta –present-day Mérida, Spain–, capital of the Roman province of Lusitania. Its construction was promoted by the consul Vipsanius Agrippa and was built in 16–15 BCE. It was used for Roman theatrical performances during ancient Rome.

The theatre has undergone several renovations, notably at the end of the 1st century or early 2nd century CE (possibly during the reign of Emperor Trajan), when the current facade of the scaenae frons was erected, and another in the time of Constantine I (between 330 and 340 CE), which introduced new decorative-architectural elements and a walkway around the monument. Following the theatre's abandonment in Late Antiquity, it was slowly covered with earth, with only the upper tiers of seats (summa cavea) remaining visible.

name: Random Pawpads 003
description:
Umm... hi there. I know I am absolutely out of my element here, but I decided I wanted to share this here... just in case anyone... I don't know, actually wants this, for some reason.

Long story short, using a horrible AI-generated image as a reference, I created this set of plump pawpads as a test to try to make some pawpads with as minimal polygons as possible. As one might gather from my name, pretty much all I've done in Blender thus far is create paws or simply pawpads, but so far they've all been sculpts resulting in insanely high poly counts due to the remeshing which is why I've hesitated to upload any of them here.

This one, however, I created largely using the modeling method, then sculpted it a little bit to smoothen out the shape remeshing as lightly as possible when necessary. I like how this turned out and I hope you do, too! I mean... for whatever you might need pawpads this plump for.

Personally, I've just been playing around with them using rigid body physics, so, to each their own.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: Tyrannosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The type species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning 'king' in Latin), often shortened to T. rex or colloquially t-rex, is one of the best represented theropods. It lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of geological formations dating to the latest Campanian-Maastrichtian ages of the late Cretaceous period, 72.7 to 66 million years ago, with isolated specimens possibly indicating an earlier origin in the middle Campanian. It was the last known member of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyrannosaurus

The “Hinged” Gallows is a fundamental component of all anchoring devices equipped with a catching arm of the “Hinged” type. The gallows allows for simple assembly and disassembly, which can be performed in just two steps. The catching arm features an innovative solution — a breakable (hinged) joint — that protects the device from tearing due to high forces that may occur, for example, during a rescue operation.
The gallows is equipped with a lifting sling.

name: Spider Cow
description:
**The Spidercow: A Nightmare Bred in the Hollow Vale**

In the fog-choked marshes of Hollow Vale, villagers whisper of the Spidercow, a grotesque fusion of bovine bulk and arachnid limbs. Born from a failed alchemical ritual meant to cure livestock disease, the Spidercow emerged when a dying cow was injected with spider ichor harvested from the Vale’s venomous pit-dwellers. Instead of healing, the creature mutated overnight, sprouting eight clawed legs and a maw lined with tusks.

Legends say it weaves webs from sinew and bone, dragging prey into its lair beneath the old mill. Its multiple eyes reflect torchlight like wet obsidian, and its bellow, half moo, half screech, echoes through the valley during moonless nights. Farmers leave offerings of salt and iron at crossroads to ward it off, but sightings persist. Some claim it guards a buried relic, others believe it’s multiplying. Either way, the Spidercow is no myth. It’s waiting.

name: Spea bombifrons (MSB:Herp:106628)
description:
The Plains spadefoot toad lives in the central U.S., southern Canada, and northern Mexico. Named for the black “spade” on its hind feet, it digs into sandy soil and spends most of its life underground. After heavy rains, it emerges to breed in temporary pools. Its call sounds like a snore, and its tadpoles can develop in just days before the pools dry. It can speed up or delay development based on environmental conditions—an adaptation to dry habitats (Bragg; Pfennig). It helps balance prairie ecosystems by eating insects and serving as prey.

References:

* Bragg, A. N. (1965). Gnomes of the Night: The Spadefoot Toads.
* Pfennig, D. W. (1992). Polyphenism in spadefoot toad tadpoles as a locally adjusted evolutionarily stable strategy. Evolution, 46(5), 1408–1420.
* [Animal Diversity Web](https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Spea_bombifrons/)
* [MSB:Herp:106628](https://arctos.database.museum/guid/MSB:Herp:106628) (Division of Amphibians and Reptiles, Museum of Southwestern Biology, University of New Mexico)

name: The Redeemed Warrior
description:
The Redeemed Warrior is a minor character that makes a cameo in the beginning of God of War: Ascension. He also serves as the player's customizable warrior in the multiplayer mode.
During Kratos' pursuit of Megaera, he travels through the prison made within Aegaeon. Kratos crashes into a cell containing a lonely prisoner who is rejoiced to see an opportunity for freedom from his prison.
Then, as an infected arm of the Hecatonchires rips apart the cell, the prisoner prays to the gods just as its claw is about to strike, he vanishes from his chains into a beam of light, much to Kratos' surprise.
The prisoner would find redemption for his unknown crimes and was transported to the Rotunda of Olympus. There he would start his trials to become a warrior of the gods.
After entering multiplayer mode for the first time, it will replay the cutscene from the campaign of your warrior's origin as a prisoner mentioned above, but from the point of view of the Warrior.

description:
This character was created as part of a school project. I wanted to explore shape language, proportions, and how to give personality to a character through a simple but expressive design.

I focused on keeping the silhouette clean and easy to read, while adding enough detail to make the character feel alive from different angles. I also paid attention to the overall anatomy and balance of the model.

For the textures and materials, I tried to keep things cohesive and support the character’s vibe without making it too busy.

Overall, this project helped me improve my skills in 3D modeling, texturing, and presentation, and it was a really good learning experience.

name: Estatua de komainu o perro guardián
description:
Modelo 3D fotogramétrico de una estatua de piedra que representa a un "Komainu" o perro guardián, una estatua guardiana mítica que se encuentra comúnmente en las entradas de los santuarios sintoístas japoneses y algunos templos budistas.
·
No sorprende, por tanto, que la encontremos en el jardín de la Fonte Baixa, en Luarca (Principado de Asturias), un lugar que invita a la calma, donde cada sendero y cada sombra cuentan una historia. 
·
El bosque-jardín de la Fonte Baxa tiene una superficie de unas 20 hectáreas y cuenta con cientos de árboles diferentes traídos de todos los rincones del mundo.
·
El empresario y aristócrata español José Rivera de Larraya, junto con su esposa Rosa María Pardo, en la década de los 90 convirtieron este valle, gracias al diseño de Laura Rodríguez y Rafael Ovalle, en uno de los jardines botánicos privados más grandes de Europa. 
·
Más información sobre Fonte Baxa aquí:

name: Helen
description: Not much is written about the 90 ft scow schooner Helen. It was built in 1881 by Wolf and Davidson in Milwaukee and was driven ashore and sank during a storm in 1886 enroute to Chicago with a cargo of what appears to be Iron ore. Although the wreck occurred scarcely one-hundred yards from shore, all five or six of the crew perished in the tragic wreck event. Although the Helen was not documented to be of composite construction, it appears the hull was constructed with steel or iron channel frames interspersed every two or three wood frames. It does make the wreck unique for a not-very-exciting shipwreck site. The model was created from 1,225 30-megapixel images shot by Andrew Goodman on one DPV dive in the 2025 season.

name: Ruine Hinterhaus
description:
The Hinterhaus ruins are located on a steep rocky ridge above Spitz an der Donau and are among the most important medieval fortifications in the Wachau region. Their origins date back to the 12th century, and they were first mentioned in a document in 1243. Their strategic location allowed control of the Danube Valley and the important trade route along the river.

In the 13th century, the castle was under the influence of the Kuenringers, who used it primarily as an administrative and security facility. In the following centuries, it changed hands several times, including to the Wallseers, the Maissauers, and later the Lords of Neidegg. From the early 16th century, the complex became the property of the Habsburgs.

The rear building is terraced and closely adapted to the rocky terrain. The complex is divided into several outer baileys and a main castle with curtain walls, battlements, and the remains of a great hall.

name: Adirondack Blue Potato
description:
The Adirondack Blue potato is a vibrant heirloom variety known for its deep blue-purple skin and striking indigo flesh, which retains its color even after cooking. Developed in the early 2000s by Cornell University, this variety is celebrated for its earthy flavor, firm texture, and high antioxidant content due to its naturally occurring anthocyanins.

The potato’s name honors the Adirondack Mountains, a region culturally significant to Indigenous nations of the Northeast, including Haudenosaunee and Algonquian-speaking peoples. The Adirondacks have long served as homelands and seasonal gathering grounds. Though potatoes are not native to the area, the name ties this heirloom to a landscape with enduring Indigenous history and meaning.

At the Indigenous Community Garden at Virginia Tech, Adirondack Blue potatoes are grown as part of ongoing efforts to promote culturally relevant crops, support community food sovereignty, and teach visitors about the diversity of heritage foods.

name: El Tumi De Oro
description:
Pertenece a la cultura Lambayeque (o Sicán), que se desarrolló entre los siglos VIII y XIV. Aunque durante mucho tiempo se atribuyó a los Chimú, estudios posteriores confirmaron su origen Lambayeque.
Originalmente, el tumi era una herramienta ritual utilizada por sacerdotes para sacrificios de animales o prisioneros, así como en trepanaciones craneanas (cirugías antiguas).
Descubierta en 1936 en la Huaca La Ventana (Lambayeque), por el arqueólogo Julio C. Tello. Fue custodiada en el Museo Nacional de Antropología y Arqueología de Lima.

name: Lùchairt Ghleann Iucha
description:
Ged a bha e aig aon àm na àite-còmhnaidh rìoghail, mòrail aig na Stiùbhartaich, tha Lùchairt Ghleann Iucha an-diugh gun mhullach air, ’s e air a sgrios. A dh’aindeoin sin, tha dhol tro gheataichean an lùchairt fhathast na chùis-iongnaidh do luchd-tadhail.

Dh’òrdaich Seumas I gun tòisicheadh obair air lùchairt ann an 1424, an dèidh do theine droch mhilleadh a dhèanamh air an àite-còmhnaidh a bh’ ann roimhe. Dh’fhàs an ‘lùchairt toileachaidh’ eireachdail, ùr gu bhith na h-àite-tàimh, ris an dèanadh buill den teaghlach rìoghail toileachas, air an rathad trang eadar Caisteal Dhùn Èideann agus Caisteal Shruighlea.

Tha Lùchairt Ghleann Iucha na sheasamh air cnoc ìosal os cionn loch bheag a-staigh san tìr. Tha an t-ainm Gleann Iucha a’ ciallachadh ‘an loch anns an lagan tais’.

name: Shipwreck Into  (Sottunga, Finland)
description:
© Maritime Archaeological Society of Finland / Teemu Kerola

The wreck of galleon Into lies in 23-25 m depth on sandy bottom in Sottunga, Finland. Into was built in 1906.

Into was over 20m long. It was carrying cargo of bricks when it sprang a leak in a storm and sunk in September 1932 East of Bogskär in Sottunga, Åland, Finland.

The bow is in better shape, but the stern pretty much in gone. The ship's bell is still there on top of the anchor winch. The oven lies alone behind the broken stern. The broken steering wheel lies on the left side behind the stern, but it is not shown in the model. There are some dishes scattered on the sea floor left of the stern.

Photo: Teemu Kerola, Samuli Haataja and Ilkka Järvinen
Model: Teemu Kerola

More information:

name: Bronze Ceremonial Headpiece/ Mask - Panjuruli
description:
This is a 3D photogrammetry model of an antique bronze ceremonial headpiece/ "mask". The mask is that of Panjuruli, a (wild-boar) deity, from the Bhootaradhane (Bhoothakola) pantheon. This artefact is used, mostly by the people of Tulunada (coastal Karnataka, India), in ritual and ceremonial performances. 

3D scan information:

* Method: Photogrammetry (captured images on a ~2k camera)

* No. of images: 471 images 

* Reconstruction: RealityScan, by Epic Games, in 03h:30m.


This artefact is a part of a living cultural tradition. It has been scanned, digitised and shared with the intent of cultural documentation, heritage preservation and increasing educational accessibility.

name: Vaso
Calderstones Phase 2 - Stone F
description:
This dataset represents Phase 2 of the Calderstones heritage project, carried out by Geo Scan Surveying Ltd after the stones were excavated and transferred from Calderstones Park in Liverpool to Orbis Conservation Ltd. in London for cleaning, preservation and specialist analysis.

With the stones removed from their previous setting, previously buried or inaccessible surfaces became available for documentation. Using precise 3D laser scanning and high-resolution photogrammetry, we captured each individual stone (A–F) in full detail — including engravings, weathered markings and features that had never been recorded before.

The Phase 2 datasets were then aligned with the Phase 1 conservatory scans, allowing the entire monument to be digitally reassembled for the first time. This comprehensive record supports heritage conservation, archaeological study and long-term public access.

name: Chatter Phone - toy
description: Once a staple of childhood across generations, the **Fisher-Price Chatter Telephone**—with its rolling wheels, googly eyes, and cheerful rotary dial—now teeters on the edge of cultural extinction. Introduced in 1961, this iconic pull toy helped millions of toddlers develop motor skills and imagination, all while trailing behind them like a loyal plastic companion. But in an age of touchscreen tablets and AI learning tools, the humble Chatter Telephone is being phased out from shelves, dismissed as obsolete. Vintage collectors hoard them, and toy historians warn that without preservation, future children may never encounter its clacking charm or giggling ring. Advocacy groups have begun pushing for its inclusion in museum collections and nostalgic reissues. Protecting the Chatter Telephone isn’t just about saving a toy—it’s about honoring a piece of analog joy that once gave voice to play, long before screens took over.

name: Zx Spectrum 128K || Computer
description:
# ZX Spectrum 128K (Toastrack)
The ZX Spectrum 128K, nicknamed "Toastrack" due to its prominent heat sink, was the last Sinclair-designed Spectrum model before the brand was acquired by Amstrad. Released in 1985, it featured a Zilog Z80A CPU, 128 KB of RAM, improved sound with the AY-3-8912 chip, and support for memory paging. Despite limited initial availability, it became a cult classic, bridging the gap between the original Spectrum line and the later Amstrad models. Its distinctive design and expanded capabilities made it a favorite among enthusiasts and developers alike.

name: Low Poly Medieval Tavern Props Pack (30)
description:
Thirty flat-shaded low poly medieval tavern props - 9,052 triangles in total - built at real-world metric scale with base-level pivots and eight shared solid-colour materials.

The set covers what a tavern interior needs. Storage: three crates, three barrels (two upright, one lying on its side) and a closed chest. Seating and tables: a long table, a round table, a bench, two stools and a chair. Tableware: a wooden mug, a tankard, two bottles, a plate and a bowl. Lighting: a wall torch, a standing torch, a candle holder and a lantern. Dressing: a wall shelf, a hanging sign, a coil of rope, a bucket, two sacks and a firewood pile.

Full pack with FBX, OBJ, GLB and BLEND files, Royalty Free licence: https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/furniture/table/low-poly-medieval-tavern-props-pack-30-game-ready-models
